subject.title: feat(control-ui): agent identity editor, Settings-homed Agents page, scalable chip switcher

question: Should Agents remain a customizable primary sidebar destination as well as a Settings page, or should the product intentionally migrate users to a Settings-only destination?
rationale: The patch changes a persisted navigation contract and can discard an existing user preference; code review cannot determine whether that UX break is intentional.

options.title: Preserve Both Surfaces
options.body: Keep Agents available to existing sidebar pins while also exposing it under Settings, and migrate navigation only after an explicit deprecation plan.

options.title: Approve Settings-Only
options.body: Accept the relocation as intentional, but add a tested migration or user-visible handling for existing Agents pins and document the changed navigation contract.

options.title: Split Navigation Work
options.body: Land the identity editor and switcher improvements separately while deferring the sidebar relocation for focused product review.

recommendation.title: Preserve Both Surfaces
recommendation.body: Keep Agents available to existing sidebar pins while also exposing it under Settings, and migrate navigation only after an explicit deprecation plan.

likelyOwner.reason: The available context shows this person self-assigned and actively carrying the proposed Control UI direction, although independent ownership history could not be verified.
